{{Quote|Our delectable, fluffy omelets are prepared to your request. Enjoy our basic omelet, made from three Grade Aurek garto eggs and filled with shredded jerba cheese, or add any of these favorite ingredients for a small charge: diced gornt, diced roba, Felucian glasscap mushrooms, Ferroan spinach, Bellassan peppers, Ojomian onions, topatoes or calarantrum root.|The omelete's description at Dex's|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Bellassan peppers''' were a type of [[Vegetable/Legends|pepper]] used in cooking. It was one of many additional [[Foodstuff/Legends|ingredients]] that customers could choose to add to a [[gartro egg omelet]] at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The omelet consisted of three [[Grade Aurek]] [[gartro]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]], and was filled with [[jerba cheese]]. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] and owner of Dex's Diner, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], considered the omelet with any of the additional ingredients, including Bellassan peppers, to be delicious. The dish cost 7.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], with the addition of the peppers costing another 5 [[Decicred/Legends|decicreds]]. Bellassan peppers were available as an ingredient at Dex's<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> It shared its name with the planet [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]].<ref name="DaD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bellassan peppers were mentioned in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the form of an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="DaD" />
